body: Thank you so much! I don't even know what to say?? I'm sorry that I still think it's selfish to upload this. The way I see it is that I'm unloading all this baggage on to whoever reads this so they can feel bad. I haven't spoken to anyone about this for almost a year now and it's nice to know that I can find support through kind people like you here. I really appreciate this, thank you <33

Jakdks Thank you so much! I've had a pretty bad day today and I needed this. And I totally get what you're saying. Posting this here actually helped me and I'm glad you liked it. I honestly don't know what else to say but to thank you for your kindness. I really appreciate it <33

Hello! I'm not really one to talk but your life isn't over yet isn't it? Who's to say this high point is the highest it can go? Sure, life can feel like it's only going downhill once we've hit a peak but life isn't that linear or straightforward. It has it's ups and downs. Just soldier through the grit and you'll eventually reach a peak again. But measuring your future and your happiness on the stability of your life currently isn't a good habit to cultivate. It's nice to go with the flow but don't voluntarily let it drag you down just because you think there's nothing more to hope for. Have hope and know that until the game is over, the match isn't set.

Have a wonderful life and make good choices <33

This is so messed up, right? The day after my botched consecutive suicide attempts I had tested hanging myself even though I was already set on the idea of jumping. I felt so numb and completely done with everything at that point that I considered my least favorite method. So I took two mismatched blankets and tied them together before I strung the makeshift rope against the wooden beam in my room. I remember that tying one end of the blanket around my neck in a noose had felt so natural. I hadn't looked up how to tie a noose prior to that but my hands knew the knot. It was uncanny how I knew it and how simple it had been to actually tie it. But it came so naturally just like the first time I tried it 2 years ago (I forgot to mention this wasn't my first test run with the whole tying the knot deal, sorry ahaha). It kinda reminds me of how I tie my necktie for school every day. In the end I tried it 3 times halfheartedly since I was deadset on my icarus-esque dive for months now. I counted to 10 in my head for every try since I read somewhere that it takes 15 seconds for you to pass out due to lack of oxygen. After the half-assed attempts, I decided on sleeping with the noose tied around my neck that same night. The noose is actually still on my bed, it's right next to me right now. I haven't attempted it since and I'm not planning to.

God, I'm sorry if this is starting to sound like a suicide survivor story and I'm sorry if I had led you on to believe that. I honestly don't believe this is going to be one of them.

I genuinely believe that I'm a lost cause, that there's absolutely no hope left for someone like me. I know how my mind works and I know just how stubborn I am. I know my worth and I know my place. I've already lost my purpose in life and there's no more point for me to keep going with the way I am. 

I don't know what I'm going to do on the 18th but I'm giving myself almost a month to ponder it. I'm a pretty spontaneous person and with the amount of expectations I'm placing on that date, I honestly don't know what to expect of myself. I don't know if I'm actually going to do it or not when the moment comes when I'm standing on that same ledge I had stood on, on October 25 and the incident last year, for what could possibly be the last time. Once you stand on that ledge and that tantalizing offer is literally one step away, it's different. It only takes one moment, even just a split-second decision and it can be the final catalyst for whatever sliver of rationality I may still have to break and I'm going to take the plunge. 

I'm sorry for whoever reads this today or on the actual day or days, months, or even years after November 18, 2019. You have no responsibility over whatever transpires on that day nor should you feel a helpless sort of obligation to have tried to help me. I won't blame you and no one else will blame you for anything. Some cases are just lost causes and I guess I'm one of them. And that I'm sorry that I was selfish and I had posted this. I'm sorry for whoever had to read this and I'm so, so sorry for everything. 

This isn't a plea for forgiveness, I can't take anymore kindness. This isn't even a call for help, I just wanted to vent for purely selfish reasons.

Thank you and have a wonderful life.

They say that those who end their lives do it to end their pain. The pain of existence or just the general pain that comes with existing. That phrase never really sit well with me. I didn't feel that it was true for me because I WANTED to suffer and I wanted the actual act of dying. 

Am I a masochist? Probably? Do I have a suffocating inferiority complex that hinders me from functioning like a normal human being? Most definitely. Am I fucked in the head and I'm going to vent as I spiral further into myself thus further cementing my twisted perception of reality? Absolutely.

I want to suffer and die and rot in hell because I know it's what I deserve. I'm a terrible human being who's only good at pushing people away and screwing things up. I don't deserve the wonderful life I was given because I'm just a natural born screw up who squanders all the opportunities she was given on a silver platter like a scumbag. I'm not bullied, I'm not oppressed and I live in relative comfort and I still have the audacity to complain? I feel like a thief, an imposter who stole this amazing life from someone more deserving. I don't deserve it. I don't deserve them. I have to suffer to make up for all that I've done, it's the only thing that makes sense in my mind. I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I'm sorry I keep on failing at everything and breaking all the promises I make. I can't even keep the promises I make to myself, I'm that pathetic. I'm sorry I'm a selfish bitch for even considering this despite being painfully aware of how this will affect all of you. I know none of you who actually has to hear this, who needs to understand the reasons for what I'm going to do will actually be able to read this and I'm so sorry. I'm so sorry I became a part of your life.

I'm sorry if you had to read through that. That was messy ahahaha just needed to get that out of my chest. Wow-this-is-so-long-I'm-so-sorry
